Executive officer of the Space Noah-class multipurpose
battleship Hagane, flagship of the
<Earth Federation Army>'s 1st Independent Special
Squadron, known as the "<Steel Dragons>." Honest and
upright, he is deeply trusted by his subordinates.

strings.en:
A bridge operator on the Hagane, second ship of the Space
Noah-class multipurpose battleships.
He mainly handles sensors. A skilled operator, but easygoing
and always saying one word too many. Before the <DC War>, he
served as a bridge operator on the first ship, the Shirogane,
and that connection led Tetsuya to recommend him for the
Hagane.

strings.en:
A bridge operator on the Hagane, second ship of the Space
Noah-class multipurpose battleships.
Mainly in charge of communications. Originally on the
second bridge, but reassigned to the first bridge after the
<Shura Revolt>. Quiet and reserved, but a bit scatterbrained.
A huge cat lover and a good singer.

strings.en:
Captain of the Hiryu-class general-purpose battleship
Hiryu Custom of the <Earth Federation Army>'s 1st
Independent Special Squadron, known as the
"<Steel Dragons>."
A gifted young woman who graduated top of her class
from the space officer academy at Icarus Base in the
asteroid belt. Graceful, a worrier and quick to tears, but
with a strong core.

strings.en:
Executive officer of the Hiryu-class general-purpose
battleship Hiryu Custom.
A soft-spoken English gentleman. With his wealth of
knowledge and experience and his sense of humor, he gives
Lefina just the right support. A heavy drinker and a
connoisseur of Western liquor.

strings.en:
Bridge operator of the Hiryu-class multipurpose
battleship Hiryu Custom.
Serious and something of a neat freak, but
personable. She and Lefina were classmates at the
space officer academy, and she always watches
over her. Promoted to Second Lieutenant.

strings.en:
Captain of the Kurogane, third ship of the Space
Noah-class multipurpose battleships.
Originally an officer of the <United Colony Corps>, he was
seconded to the <DC> along with Rätsel and served as
executive officer of the Space Noah-class Kurogane.
After the <L5 Campaign>, he stayed with Rätsel and took
charge of the Kurogane.

strings.en:
A pilot in the <Steel Dragons>' <SRX Team>.
Hot-blooded, impulsive and reckless, and a huge super robot
fanatic. A bit childish at times, but he has some of the
strongest willpower on the team. He is also a <Telekinetic>.
Rank: Second Lieutenant.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A pilot in the <Steel Dragons>' <SRX Team>.
He comes from the Branstein family, a distinguished
military line. Calm and collected, and an exceptional pilot.
A little sarcastic, but he also shows a passionate side with
a strong sense of duty. Rank: Second Lieutenant.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A pilot in the <Steel Dragons>' <SRX Team>, and the team's
leader.
She has a special power of the mind, "telekinesis," and
before joining the military she was a test subject at the
Japan Special Brain Medicine Institute, assisting her
father's research. When the <SRX Project> was launched, she
became a <Military Contractor> and was involved in developing
the <T-LINK System>.
She has a strong sense of responsibility and looks after
others. She appears tough on the outside, but is truly a kind
woman who dislikes fighting. Rank: Captain.

strings.en:
Captain of the <Steel Dragons>' <SRX Team>.
She was once a double agent for the <Aerogators>.
A rational, composed adult woman. She speaks little and
gives others a cold impression, but she simply doesn't
show more emotion than necessary. An expert in
infiltration, she also takes part in the <SRX Project>. Age
unknown. Rank: Captain.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A pilot in the <Steel Dragons>' <SRX Team>.
Aya Kobayashi's younger sister, though records listed her as
killed in an accident. Quiet and gentle, she has no memories
of her past.
Found after the <L5 Campaign>, she recovered under the care
of her father, Dr. Kenzou Kobayashi, and was then assigned
to the SRX Team as a trainee.

strings.en:
Captain of the <Steel Dragons>' <ATX Team>.
His taciturn nature makes him seem cool, but he simply
doesn't show his feelings; in truth, he burns with a quiet
passion. He loves gambling, and the worse the odds, the
more fired up he gets. He and Excellen are lovers, and
though he rarely shows it, he cherishes her above all else.
Rank: First Lieutenant.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A pilot in the <Steel Dragons>' <ATX Team>.
At heart she is cool and intelligent, but her flamboyant
self-promotion and breezy way of talking keep others from
seeing her that way. She resents that Kyosuke always treats
her coldly, but she loves him more than anyone. A superb
pilot, she is especially good at high-mobility and ranged
combat. A heavy drinker who enjoys watching the drunks
around her. Rank: Second Lieutenant.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A pilot in the <Steel Dragons>' <ATX Team>.
Kind and gentle, but her drive when it counts is remarkable. A
health product fanatic who loves baths. She has telekinesis
and pilots a unit equipped with the <T-LINK System>. She and
Bullet are lovers.

strings.en:
A pilot in the <Steel Dragons>' <ATX Team>, known as Bullet.
A serious young man devoted to duty and loyalty. He has a
strong sense of justice and hates anything crooked. He
tends to get dragged around by the reckless Kyosuke and
Excellen. He has an aptitude for the special power of the
mind, "telekinesis," and pilots a unit equipped with the
<T-LINK System>. Rank: Second Lieutenant.

strings.en:
A prototype of the artificial humans called <Idealand>, created
in "Project Idealands," a plan to govern the people through a
superior race pursued by the "<Gaia Savers>," the special
operations unit under the direct command of the
<Earth Federation Government>'s President. Arieil is the
second of them; intelligent, thoughtful and modest.
During <The Sealing War>, she learned of the Gaia Savers'
conspiracy and deserted. She then made contact with the
<Steel Dragons> and traveled with them. She now belongs to
the squadron's <ATX Team>.

strings.en:
A prototype of the artificial humans called <Idealand>, created
in "Project Idealands," a plan to govern the people through a
superior race pursued by the "<Gaia Savers>," the special
operations unit under the direct command of the
<Earth Federation Government>'s President. Duban is the first
of them; brilliant, proud, fierce and aggressive. During
<The Sealing War>, he piloted the <Ares Geist> and fought Arieil
and the <Steel Dragons>, and was defeated.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A pilot in the <Steel Dragons>.
A highly cultured man with a quick tongue and quick hands.
A ladies' man whose targets span a wide age range. He
once belonged to the special unit PTX Team and is a
first-rate pilot. He also sees the big picture and won't shy
from ruthless means to reach his goals. His father is
Jonathan Kazahara, a leading figure at the
<Tesla Reich Institute> and one of the developers of the
Super Fighting Robot Grungust. Rank: First Lieutenant.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
One of the <Machinery Children> created by the alien <Euzeth>
Gozzo. Specially conditioned, he has immense telekinetic
power. He once belonged to the <Gaia Savers>, but deserted
and was taken in by the <Steel Dragons> after losing his
memories. He was destined to fuse with the "man-made god
<Gan Eden>" that appeared near the end of <The Sealing War>,
but he refused that fate and even defeated Euzeth.
After the war, he joined the Steel Dragons' PTX Team. Ing
chose the surname "Wish" himself after talking it over with
Ryoto and Rio of the same team.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A pilot in the <Steel Dragons>. A shy, kind-hearted boy.
He tends to see things pessimistically. He is not very good at
telling others how he feels, and he dislikes himself for it. He
loves tinkering with machines, and that hobby led him to take
part in developing new <Personal Trooper>s.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A pilot in the <Steel Dragons>.
A cheerful, earnest girl with a strong sense of justice. She
hates to lose and speaks her mind clearly about what she
believes is right. Still, she is open-minded enough to admit it
when others point out her mistakes. Her father, Yuan, is an
executive at <Mao Industries>.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Captain of the <Earth Federation Army>'s
<Special Tactics Instructor Unit>.
A career soldier who rose through the ranks and believes in
leading from the field. He was once feared as a demon
captain, but has mellowed somewhat since the <L5 Campaign>.
With Latune and the others, he creates motion data for
mainline units and tests new models. Rank: Major.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A pilot in the <Earth Federation Army>
<Special Tactics Instructor Unit>.
Possesses exceptional combat and piloting skills,
and is calm and composed to the point of seeming
mechanical. An intelligent, quiet beauty, yet she
has an air about her that is somehow inhuman.
In truth, she is an artificial human of the type
known as the "W Series." Once a spy for the
<Shadow Mirror> unit, she awakened to her own sense
of self after meeting Kyosuke and the others.
She now serves as Kai's de facto adjutant in the
<Instructors>.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A pilot in the <Earth Federation Army>'s
<Special Tactics Instructor Unit>. He previously belonged to
the 3rd Special Operations <PT> Unit "Cry Wolves." He was
mortally wounded in the operation that destroyed that
unit, and the parts he lost were replaced with artificial
ones. Having faced poverty since childhood, he clings
fiercely to life. His emotions run high, but he usually
speaks little. Partnered with Aqua Centrum, he pilots a
humanoid mobile weapon called the TE Absorber.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A pilot in the <Earth Federation Army>'s
<Special Tactics Instructor Unit>. She pilots a humanoid
mobile weapon called the TE Absorber with Hugo Medio.
Cheerful, with a scatterbrained side. Her father is Taylor
Centrum, a senator in the Federation Congress. She was
raised wanting for nothing, but hated living like a caged
bird, and joined the <Federation Army> seeking excitement
and a place to prove herself. Her swimsuit-like outfit is a
DFC (Direct Feeling Control) suit, needed to pilot the TE
Absorber.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A pilot in the <Earth Federation Army>
<Special Tactics Instructor Unit>.
Cheerful and upbeat, and easygoing in appearance,
but serious at heart. A product of <The School>.
After the <L5 Campaign>, he joined the remnants of
the <DC> and opposed Kyosuke's group.
Later, after meeting Latune and the others, he
came to fight alongside them.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A pilot in the <Earth Federation Army>'s
<Special Tactics Instructor Unit>.
A graduate of <The School>, she is partnered with Arado. A
serious honor-student type, strong-willed and
short-tempered. She jumps to conclusions and is scary
when angry. But she truly cares about others and always
worries about her partner Arado.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A pilot in the <Earth Federation Army>'s
<Special Tactics Instructor Unit>.
A graduate of <The School>, she shows outstanding skill at
piloting and fighting in <Personal Trooper>s. The School's
harsh experiments and training made her close her heart,
but meeting Ryusei and the others restored her humanity.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Princess of the Principality of Ricsent, a special
Federation autonomous zone on the Mediterranean.
Innocent and curious, she acts the moment an idea
strikes her. She is close friends with Latooni and
harbors a faint crush on Rydeas. She also possesses
the power of foresight.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Captain of the <Steel Dragons>' Octopus Squad (Octo
Platoon).
A hot-blooded, headstrong, combative woman. The type
to act before thinking, she has a harsh way of speaking
and many violations of orders. But her piloting skill is solid,
and surprisingly, she looks after her subordinates well.
Rank: First Lieutenant.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A pilot in the <Steel Dragons>' Octopus Squad.
Kind and gentle. He worries about the reckless Katina and
acts as her restraint. Both in daily life and on missions, he
supports others: an unsung pillar of strength.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A pilot in the <Steel Dragons>' Octopus Squad.
Carefree and optimistic. He loves contests of chance and
calls himself a gambler, always testing his luck. He is
easygoing but quick-witted, with keen insight. He is good
with his hands and skilled at magic tricks, but is actually
hopeless at sports. Rank: Second Lieutenant.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A pilot in the <Steel Dragons>' Octopus Squad.
She comes from the Garstein family, a branch of the
Branstein family. She is a cousin of Rai and Elzam. Cool,
proud and strong-willed. She gives off an air that keeps
others away, but because she lives trying to measure up, she
is actually weak to others' sympathy. She seems able to do
anything with ease, but she is a poor cook. Rank: Second
Lieutenant.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A pilot of the Kurogane, third ship of the Space Noah-class
multipurpose battleships.
A bold warrior who stays true to his beliefs. He values
righteousness and always strives to act fairly and squarely,
but he can be inflexible. An expert in close combat, especially
swordsmanship.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A mysterious figure who helps the <Steel Dragons> from the
shadows.
Composed, proud and devoted to a greater cause. He also
thinks flexibly, always acting with the big picture in mind. A
genius at piloting humanoid mobile weapons, he always calls
the unit he pilots by the name of his beloved horse, "Trombe"
(German for "tornado"). A true gourmet whose cooking is
also top-class.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A young man aboard the Kurogane, third ship of the Space
Noah-class multipurpose battleships, who serves as the
dedicated pilot of the special humanoid mobile weapon RaiOh.
He has a dry outlook, but is at heart an earnest, good young
man. Frank by nature, he looks after others. He is a bit
stubborn, though, and once he makes up his mind, he can lose
flexibility. He was a civilian busy with part-time jobs, but
during <The Sealing War> he made contact with the
<Steel Dragons> and traveled with them. After the war, he
works on the Kurogane.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A pilot of the Kurogane, third ship of the Space Noah-class
multipurpose battleships.
Calm and collected, he always strives to behave like a
gentleman. He hates base conduct and never hesitates to
help the weak. He loves black tea and is particular about how
it is brewed and drunk.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A pilot assigned to the Kurogane, third ship of the
Space Noah-class multipurpose battleships. Goes by
Carla.
A passionate, tomboyish girl. An optimist, the type
to forget minor worries after a good night's sleep.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A man who once belonged to <Shadow Mirror>.
He has excellent piloting and martial arts skills. Basically
cool, but he hides fiery emotions inside.
In the world they originally came from, he saw Kyosuke
Nanbu, who had gained a mysterious power, and Kyosuke's
unit, the Gespenst Mk-III, as dangerous. Predicting that
the Kyosuke of this world would eventually gain a similar
power, he tried to defeat him.
But at the end of the <Inspector Incident>, he lost the final
battle inside the <White Star> and was mortally wounded. He
was later recovered along with his unit, the Soulgain, by
the <Earth Federation Army>'s 3rd Special Operations <PT>
Unit Cry Wolves, and fought alongside Kyosuke and the
others during the <Shura Revolt>.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A girl, the only <Einst> with a near-human form. Being a
clone-like being created from Excellen Browning's data,
she resembles her in face and voice.
During the <Inspector Incident>, she fought Kyosuke and the
others many times, but was gradually drawn to the "power
of human feelings," and in the end she became their ally
and fought the Einst leader, Stern Neu Regisseur.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A high school student living in the Asakusa district of Japan.
The grandson of local inventor Kisaburo Azuma. He gives
others a gruff impression, but is a boy with a strong sense of
justice. Quick to pick a fight, he loves festivals and spends
money freely. He also dotes on his little sister. He puts on
the Roa Armor and transforms into Fighter Roar.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A mysterious warrior from another world.
His body was lost in a past battle, and he moved his
soul into the crystal set in the Roa Armor. When
Kota wears the armor, he links with Kota's mind and
gives him sound advice.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Kota's sister. A cheerful, lively girl who does all
the housework. Friendly and popular at school. She
always worries about Kota, but nags him in person.
Unlike spendthrift Kota, she's frugal to the point
of being stingy. She dons the Emmy Armor to become
Fighter Emmy.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A senior (held back a year) at Bannamu High School in
Osaka, and a gang leader famous throughout the Kansai
region. Fearsomely strong in a fight, a man brimming with
wild energy. He tries to solve everything with force, but is
weak against cute girls. His grandfather was born in Osaka
but later moved to Tokyo, then returned to Osaka when
Michiru was 10. Partly because of that, he speaks
somewhat dubious Kansai dialect.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A test pilot in <Project TD>, which was once run by the <DC> and
is now under <Federation Army> jurisdiction.
Straightforward and strong-willed. She dreams of setting
out as an astronaut, and is a hard worker who has endured
grueling training for that goal. With Tsugumi and Sleigh, she
pilots the Hyperlion, Project TD's latest <Armored Module>.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Chief of <Project TD>'s system development team.
She keeps Project TD going with support from
<Isurugi Heavy Industries>. Basically a caring, friendly and
dependable person, but at times she makes judgments so
rational they border on ruthless.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
The pilot of the Vegalion.
The younger sister of Filio Presty, head of <Project TD>.
She has a fierce personality and shows no mercy to those
who oppose her. She has enormous confidence in her own
skill and great pride.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
The pilot of the Excellence Rescue.
Basically a hot-blooded guy with a strong sense of
responsibility who doesn't sweat the details. With his twin
sister Fiona, he founded the "<L&E Corporation>," a company
that takes on repair and rescue work, and serves as its
president.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Raul's twin sister. A strong-willed, cheerful woman. More
level-headed than Raul, she is often taken for the older twin.
Full of a spirit of challenge, she won't back down once she's
set on something. At the "<L&E Corporation>" she founded
with Raul and the others, she handles sales, cooking and
laundry, and could be called the company's real manager.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A Techniti Paides (artificial life-form) created by Duminas.
After the <Shura Revolt>, she was taken in by Raul and Fiona and
became part of the family. She works as an assistant at the
company Raul and the others founded, the "<L&E Corporation>."
Modest and quiet.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Vice president of the "<L&E Corporation>," which takes on
repair and rescue work. An excellent engineer who doesn't
care about things that don't interest him, but puts things
that do interest him first, often losing sight of everything
around him.

strings.en:
A member of the "<L&E Corporation>" and the designer of
the Excellence Rescue. Plucky and hardworking. Just as
she always wished, she built the new Excellence as a
machine for rescue work.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Known as Josh. The son of Ferio Radcliffe, a
Re-Technologist (<Re-Tech>) researching mysterious ruins
discovered in Antarctica. He has a stepsister, Cliana
Rimskaya. Not especially friendly, but calm by nature. Still,
he shows an emotional side as well.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Joshua Radcliffe's stepsister. She took part for a long time
in experiments with "<Sympathia>," a system excavated from
the Antarctic ruins and restored by the Re-Technologists,
and as a result split into two personalities: <Chris>, modest and
gentle, and Riana, strong-willed and cool. Near the end of
<The Sealing War>, in the decisive battle with the <Ruina>,
Chris's personality vanished to protect Riana. Cliana
Rimskaya now has only Riana's personality.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
One of the "<Meliores Esse>," pseudo-life-forms of the <Ruina>
that emerged from the Antarctic ruins of "<Fabula Foresse>."
During <The Sealing War>, a psychic link formed in her battles
with Joshua Radcliffe led her to resolve to live alongside him.
She broke away from the Ruina and cooperated with the
<Steel Dragons>. She places absolute trust in Joshua and
believes her life exists for him.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
An advisor at the <Tesla Reich Institute>.
A master of the Jigen-ryu school, he is involved in
developing swords for the Grungust and creating
sword motion data. He is also the teacher of Sänger
and Bullet. Strict when it comes to the way of the
sword, but otherwise a good-natured old man.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
An officer in the <Earth Federation Army>'s intelligence
department.
Calm, collected and brilliant. There is something mysterious
about him, but he also has a soft spot for duty and
compassion. He came from the <Federation Army>'s
<Special Tactics Instructor Unit>, which created the base data
for the <TC-OS>, and his skill at piloting <Personal Trooper>s is
top-class. Rank: Major.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A <Mao Industries> staff member, currently seconded to the
<Earth Federation Army>'s <Special Tactics Instructor Unit> to
provide all kinds of support.
A thoughtful, quiet woman. She has psychic sensitivity and
worked on developing man-machine interfaces at Mao
Industries. Her specialty is yoga, and since she recommends
difficult asanas (yoga poses) to others, she is a little feared.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
An envoy sent by the <Zovorg>'s <Privy Council>. During the
<Inspector Incident>, he fought the <Steel Dragons> as the
combat commander of the <Inspectors>.
Rough-spoken, but earnest at heart. He has the judgment to
read a battle calmly and the coldness to use any means to
achieve his goals. He is also chivalrous, and was once injured
shielding his younger brother Wendolo.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
The aide of Mekibos Borgue, the envoy sent to Earth by the
<Zovorg>'s <Privy Council>. Real name: Gayattoba Stecca.
During <The Sealing War>, this aide posed as an
<Earth Federation Army> officer to search for Shu Shirakawa;
Yon Gebana is the alias used at that time. Interested in
machines and well versed in humanoid mobile weapons.
Earnest, personable and studious.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A mercenary hired by the <Golaikunru>, the <Zovorg>'s war
profiteers. Lives by the creed of getting everything done
efficiently and quickly, and hates wasting time, budget or
ammunition.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
The pilot of the <Masoukishin> Cybuster. He was summoned
from Japan to the <Holy Kingdom of Langran> in the
underground world <La Gias> as part of the <Surface Dweller>
summoning project. He was later chosen by Cyfis,
Cybuster's guardian spirit, and became a Masoukishin pilot.
He is impulsive and has a disastrous sense of direction, but
he is great at sports and has a strong sense of justice.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Masaki's familiar.
A familiar cut from part of his unconscious; it doesn't share
his personality because it is one of his <Persona>. It rides in
Cybuster with Masaki and supports him. Fairly laid-back, but
rather cocky and always saying one word too many.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Masaki's familiar.
A familiar cut from part of his unconscious; it doesn't
share his personality because it is one of his <Persona>. It
rides in Cybuster with Masaki and supports him. Fairly
laid-back, but more of a worrier, and often scolds the
reckless Shiro and Masaki.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
The only daughter of <DC> leader <Bian Zoldark>.
She has superhuman motor skills, reflexes and dynamic
vision. A beauty, but a wild tomboy. Weak to flattery and
compliments. A fan of Japanese period dramas, she prefers
the slightly obscure ones. Her hobby is saving money.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A genius scientist who holds more than ten doctorates at
a young age.
A cool, handsome man with a shadowy air, calm and
collected, and tremendously self-confident. He hates
being used by others, and never forgives anyone who uses
him.
Under <Dr. Bian Zoldark> at the <EOTI Institute>, he handled
the Granzon's basic design and special equipment, and also
serves as its test pilot himself.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Shu's familiar. While Shu was on the surface, it was left in
<La Gias> to mind the house. Noisy and greedy for money.
Left alone, it will chatter on forever.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
One of the "Balshem Series" of artificial humans created
by the alien <Euzeth> Gozzo. Cool and proud. Near the end of
<The Sealing War>, in the final battle inside the <Cross Gate>,
she tried to intercept the <Steel Dragons> with Euzeth, but
was betrayed by her master. She then warped to the
underground world <La Gias>, which the gate led to, and
after many twists and turns was taken in by Shu
Shirakawa. By then she had lost her memories, and since
then she has regarded Shu, who saved her, as her new
master and serves him.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A member of the <Earth Federation Army>'s 5th Special
Operations <PT> Unit "<Team Jelba>." Rank: Second
Lieutenant. Serena's senior and her martial arts teacher.
Cheerful and bold, he is well versed in lazy cooking and
cheap eats.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A member of the <Earth Federation Army>'s 5th Special
Operations <PT> Unit "<Team Jelba>." Rank: Second Lieutenant.
A cheerful, spirited woman. She has an autonomous robot
named Elma and excels at infiltration missions. She also
loves flamenco.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
The autonomous <Sabot> (support robot) that serves as
Serena's partner. His AI has been programmed with a boy's
personality, and he has emotions. Openly and behind the
scenes, he supports Serena, handling everything from
co-piloting the Gestorben Custom to all the housework.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Captain of the <Earth Federation Army>'s 5th Special
Operations <PT> Unit "<Team Jelba>." Rank: Major. A gentle
commander who looks after his people. Serena looks up to
him like a father.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
<Earth Federation Army> marshal. A farsighted,
dry pragmatist who loves drink and grandkids.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Chairman of the <Earth Federation Army>'s Joint Chiefs of
Staff. Rank: General. Gaspar's right hand. Cautious, with a
bureaucrat's temperament. For that reason, he never got
along with Norman Slay, a man of action who founded the
Earth Sphere Defense Committee.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Director of the <Earth Federation Army>'s intelligence
department. Rank: Lieutenant General. Gilliam Jaeger's
superior. A very sharp man with strong connections in
political and business circles. He was once an excellent
special agent.
Gilliam places absolute trust in him, and he in turn recognizes
Gilliam's abilities. He always woos women he likes with style
and finesse. He was married once, but lost his wife in an
accident.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Commander of the <Earth Federation Army> Space Force's 3rd
Orbital Patrol Squadron. Rare in the Space Force, he was
born on Earth yet rose to command a ship. He does not like
the existence of specialized forces like the <Steel Dragons>.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Commander of the <Earth Federation Army> Far East
Command's Izu Base.
Mild-mannered and personable. He looks like a small, gentle
old man and seems like a bit of a slacker, but he was once
famous as a brilliant strategist at the <Federation Army>
Joint Chiefs of Staff.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Deputy commander of the <Earth Federation Army>'s Far
East Command.
Laker's right-hand man and an excellent staff officer. A
nervous realist who can be inflexible. But that comes from
wanting to keep losses as low as possible and caring for
the safety of his subordinates.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Formerly President of the Colony Government, which
oversees the 10 space colonies, he has also served as
acting President of the <Earth Federation Government>. A
politician skilled at negotiation, and a pacifist.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A senator in the <Earth Federation Government>'s Congress
and Aqua Centrum's father. Earnest by nature, a doting and
worried father. He always worries about Aqua, who left home
to join the military.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A key member of the <SRX Project>.
A young genius of robotics. Cheerful and friendly, he grew
up admiring robots from childhood. He worked on
developing the Grungust series at the
<Tesla Reich Institute> and now takes part in the Far East
Command's SRX Project. He is also the developer of
<Burning PT>, and he and Ryusei often get carried away
talking about robots.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A key member of the <SRX Project>.
An excellent engineer, and one of the creators of the
<Personal Trooper>. A cold perfectionist, yet for some
reason he gets along with Robert, his complete opposite.
He and Marion were also once married.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A central figure of the <ATX Project>.
A brilliant scientist, but a workaholic with a strong need
for attention and a jealous streak. She also developed the
Alteisen and Weissritter, and is now developing new
prototypes at <Mao Industries>.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A brilliant scientist who once belonged to the
<EOTI Institute>, now developing new mobile weapons in the
Tsentr Project. Also one of the Granzon's designers.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
One of the Re-Technologists, and one of the developers of
the Aile Chevalier and Blanche Neige. An eccentric and a
rationalist. He is close to Josh and Rim and looks out for
them like a big brother.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A scientist who researched System LIOH alongside father
Kaoru Tohmine. Troubled by a world of endless war, this
scientist has a strong sense of justice and mission, but
years of research cut off from the outside world have left
them a little out of touch.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Director of the <Tesla Reich Institute>.
Irm's father and Robert's former boss. An authority on
robotics whose talent in the field rivals that of the late
<Bian Zoldark>. But he himself is easygoing, fond of jokes and
fond of women. He is also the creator of the Grungust series.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Head of the special archaeology division of the LTR (Lost
Technology Research) Organization.
She investigates and studies the "<Choukijin>" created in
ancient China. Despite her flashy looks, she is an intelligent,
composed woman. She is passionate about her research and
often loses sight of everything around her. She is also the
type who easily gets caught up in trouble.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A member of Project Ark (species preservation plan)
and creator of Magus, the <Earth Cradle>'s
management computer. A rational realist, she seems
aloof, all the more so for her beauty, but she has a
kind, caring heart.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A key member of the <SRX Project>.
The developer of the <T-LINK System>, and the father of Aya
and Mai. He was once known as a maverick of the brain
medicine world, and at the Japan Special Brain Medicine
Institute he made "the return of humanity's latent ESP" his
life's work. He is taciturn and dislikes dealing with people.
Aya and Mai are not his real daughters, but their family bond
is strong.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Kota and Shoko's grandfather.
Director of the Azuma Laboratory in Asakusa (though the
only person who could be called staff is Shoko, who handles
the accounts). A hot-blooded man with a strong sense of
justice. He takes care of others and also serves as head of
the neighborhood association. He always seems to be making
useless inventions, but he is actually a highly skilled robotics
scholar.
Meeting Roa taught him of the evil that targets Earth, and
he repaired the Compatible Kaiser that Roa brought. Once a
rich man with many patents, he has poured most of his
fortune into building the Compatible Kaiser and its facilities.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
President of <Mao Industries>, the maker of <Personal Trooper>s.
Cool-headed and a rationalist. Influenced by her father, the
founder of Mao Industries, she set out to become a Personal
Trooper pilot, and once belonged to the "PTX Team," a
special unit of the <Earth Federation Army>'s Far East branch.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
An executive at <Mao Industries>.
Rio's father. One of the members who founded Mao
Industries with Ling's father, he is now Ling's right hand.
He is a bit overprotective of his daughter and always
worries about her, since she joined the military against his
wishes.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
President of <Isurugi Heavy Industries>.
Daughter of former president Renji Isurugi, killed
in the <L5 Campaign>. A seemingly gentle, soft-spoken
beauty, but a shrewd operator. Puts profit first,
with no scruples over methods or business partners.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A young tycoon of many faces: shipping magnate,
promoter, information broker, resort hotel owner, former
boxing champion and more. He also has pull in the
underworld. An old friend of Rätsel, he handles resupplying
the Kurogane, among other things. He runs "AM Battling,"
an unofficial competition using <Armored Module>s, and owns
a custom unit of his own (a modified Guarlion).

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A girl rescued by Ibis's group on Komodin Island.
An amnesiac of unknown origin. Quiet and gentle.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
The newly appointed captain of the Space Noah-class
multipurpose battleship Hagane, flagship of the
<Steel Dragons>. Calm, thoughtful and a man of few words.
He previously captained the flagship of the 4th Orbital
Patrol Fleet.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A bounty hunter from the other world of the
"<Endless Frontier>." Captain of the land battleship "Zeit
Krokodil," he goes by the epithet "the Wandering Bounty
Hunter." Cool and nihilistic, and fond of saying "OK."

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Haken Browning's subordinate. A combat android, but
somewhat human and sharp-tongued. Usually expressionless
and calm, but when she activates "Code DTD," a processing
boost program that uses thermal runaway, she becomes
cheerful and innocent.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
The son of Zuiun Akatsuki, president of the mid-sized heavy
machinery maker "<Mogami Heavy Industries>." A cheerful,
lively high school student with a strong sense of justice.
Personable, he can get along with anyone. With his twin
sister Akemi, he serves as a test pilot of the "Soul Saber,"
the prototype <Mighty Walker> (a super robot designed for
mass production by Mogami Heavy Industries).

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
The daughter of Zuiun Akatsuki, president of the mid-sized
heavy machinery maker "<Mogami Heavy Industries>."
Energetic yet thoughtful, she often holds back her headlong
twin brother, Akimi. With him, she serves as a test pilot of
the "Soul Saber," the prototype <Mighty Walker> (a super
robot designed for mass production by Mogami Heavy
Industries).

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A woman of the alien civilization "Gadisword." A bodyguard of
Malum Quisude, the representative of the space fortress
"<Rabulpaila>." She stole an experimental craft (Earth's code
name: "Drift Wing") and came to Earth. She has a calm air and
is a woman of action. She is of the "<Anex>," one of the
dominant peoples of planet Gadisword.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.
Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A genius scientist of the alien civilization "Gadisword." He
designed the space fortress "<Rabulpaila>" and serves as its
Head Officer (director; the person in charge). He also
develops the mobile weapons operated with the Rabulpaila. A
man true to his own intellectual curiosity, and ambitious. He
was the most successful member of the people called the
"<Rattma>" on planet Gadisword.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A soldier of the alien civilization "Gadisword." Combative by
nature, he serves as Knight Leader (captain) of the unit that
tests the mobile weapons Herluga developed (currently
called the Imperial Guard). He is of the people called the
"<Rattma>" on planet Gadisword, and has sworn loyalty to his
kinsman Herluga, who trusts him deeply in return.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A man who commands the <Zovorg>'s mobile
weapon forces.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.
Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A soldier of the alien civilization "Gadisword." A soldier of
few words, calm and collected, who judges things by looking
at the big picture. Serving as Knight Leader (captain) of a
humanoid mobile weapon unit, this pilot is a famous ace in the
Gadisword military. Of the "<Anex>," one of the dominant
peoples of planet Gadisword.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A soldier of the alien civilization "Gadisword." The pilot of a
humanoid mobile weapon called the "Leonysis Harga."
Impulsive and rough-spoken, but kind to those close to him.
He and Sally Emil, who is in the same unit, are childhood
friends, and he thinks of her as his own little sister. He is of
the "<Anex>," one of the dominant peoples of planet
Gadisword.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
A soldier of the alien civilization "Gadisword." The pilot of a
humanoid mobile weapon called the "Leonysis Varga."
Cheerful and honest, with a strong core. She and Sieg
Altolied, who is in the same unit, are childhood friends, and
she looks up to him like her own big brother. She is of the
"<Anex>," one of the dominant peoples of planet Gadisword.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Captain of the "Golar Golem Unit," a special forces unit of
the alien civilization "<Ze Balmary Empire>." One of the
"Balshem Series" of artificial humans created by <Euzeth>
Gozzo.

budget.note: Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.
Variable-length; offsets are recomputed on build. Limits: 65535 code points per line, 65535 bytes of text per entry. No on-screen width limit is encoded in the file.

strings.en:
Vice captain of the "Golar Golem Unit," a special forces
unit of the alien civilization "<Ze Balmary Empire>." One of
the "Balshem Series" of artificial humans created by
<Euzeth> Gozzo.

strings.en:
A member of the "Golar Golem Unit," a special forces unit
of the alien civilization "<Ze Balmary Empire>." One of the
"Balshem Series" of artificial humans created by <Euzeth>
Gozzo.

strings.en:
A high school student living in Japan. Basically
straightforward with a sense of justice, but a bit timid, and
not the type to take the initiative. His father, Seldoa Shiun,
works at <Ashurey Kreuzer> on the Moon, so he lives alone. His
mother died several years ago.

strings.en:
A test pilot employed by <Ashurey Kreuzer>, who pilots the
humanoid mobile weapon "Bellzelute." Formerly an
<Earth Federation Army> soldier, she was an ace pilot known as
the "White Lynx." Cool and somewhat self-righteous, she
doesn't care to have much to do with others.

strings.en:
A serious, quiet girl, though a bit stubborn. Her parents
work at <Ashurey Kreuzer>, and after they called her to the
company, it came under attack by unidentified mobile
weapons, but she survived along with Melua.

strings.en:
Known as Tenia. An energetic girl who goes at everything
eagerly. She is compatible with the Bellzelute's "Cytron
Control System," and comes to fight alongside Calvina. A
big eater.

strings.en:
A modest, gentle girl who rarely asserts herself. Her parents
work at <Ashurey Kreuzer>, and after they called her to the
company, it came under attack by unidentified mobile
weapons, but she survived along with Katia. She loves
sweets.

strings.en:
A girl who rules the group called the "Fury" and holds the
position of "Princess." Graceful, thoughtful and
kind-hearted. She was pursuing a certain plan with
E-Selda Shune, the <Sentinel> Commander (captain of the
royal guard). She is also wary of the rise of Gu-Landon
Gortz, leader of the "Furia Holy Knights."

strings.en:
The <Sentinel> Commander (captain of the royal guard) who
serves Princess Shana-Mia, ruler of the group called the
"Fury." The pilot of the Throne Unit "Granteed," his skill is
said to exceed even that of Gu-Landon Gortz, leader of the
Furia Holy Knights. He is also Al-Van Ranks's teacher. He
goes by another name, Seldoa Shiun, and has an only son
(Touya Shiun).

strings.en:
A man of the "Furia Holy Knights," which could be called the
army of the group known as the "Fury." Impulsive, vindictive
and hungry for promotion. He respects his superior, Al-Van
Ranks.

strings.en:
The man who leads the "Furia Holy Knights," which could
be called the army of the group known as the "Fury." Also
called the "Knight Commander." A bold warrior, and
ambitious. While professing obedience to Princess
Shana-Mia, he is advancing a certain plan behind the
scenes.

strings.en:
A man of the "Furia Holy Knights," which could be called
the army of the group known as the "Fury." The leading
candidate to be the next Knight Commander, and a superb
knight. He pilots the humanoid mobile weapon "Raftclans
Aurun" and excels at sword combat. Serious by nature, he
prefers to fight fair and square.

The man who commands the "<Agent>s," who carry out
intelligence work, assassinations and the like for the group
called the "Fury." He holds the rank of "Chief Agent."
Calm, collected and cruel, he sides with Gu-Landon Gortz,
leader of the "Furia Holy Knights."

strings.en:
A woman of the "Furia Holy Knights," which could be called
the army of the group known as the "Fury." She pilots the
humanoid mobile weapon "Raftclans Fauneia" and excels at
ranged combat. She speaks politely, but is a valiant knight.

strings.en:
One of the "<Agent>s," who carry out intelligence work,
assassinations and the like for the group called the "Fury."
Also skilled with humanoid mobile weapons. Cruel by nature,
this Agent kills people for fun.

strings.en:
The newly appointed commander of the
<Earth Federation Army>'s 1st Independent Special
Squadron, known as the "<Steel Dragons>." A high-strung
man who is strict about discipline and won't tolerate his
subordinates acting on their own. He plans to control the
Steel Dragons completely and rise in rank through their
achievements.

strings.en:
A pilot of the <Earth Federation Army>'s 13th Special
Operations <PT> Unit. Previously a member of the "FDX
Team," a special operations PT unit of the Southern
Europe Command. Hot-tempered and foul-mouthed, but
skilled at close combat.

strings.en:
A pilot of the <Earth Federation Army>'s 13th Special
Operations <PT> Unit. Previously the leader of the "FDX
Team," a special operations PT unit of the Southern
Europe Command. Has a superb tactical eye that can find
the best answer in any battle.

strings.en:
The person who succeeded Graien Grassman, who died during
<The Sealing War>, as President of the Federation government.
Untouched by scandal, with an earnest, positive attitude
that is the source of the President's popularity.

strings.en:
An engineer at the mid-sized heavy machinery maker
"<Mogami Heavy Industries>," involved in developing the "Soul
Saber," the prototype <Mighty Walker> (a super robot designed
for mass production by Mogami Heavy Industries). Spirited
and loud, but thinks of Akimi and Akemi as family. An old
acquaintance of Kota's grandfather, Kisaburo Azuma.

strings.en:
President of the mid-sized heavy machinery maker
"<Mogami Heavy Industries>." As the threat from outside
enemies grew serious, he resolved to develop the
<Mighty Walker> (a super robot designed for mass
production). To Akimi, he is a strict, nagging parent, but
deep down he worries about his children more than anyone.

strings.en:
The Head Leader (president) of the alien civilization
"Gadisword." Originally the Minister of Environmental
Development, he was the only one aboard the space fortress
"<Rabulpaila>" in the line of succession for Head Leader
authority, so after the warp to the solar system, he became
Head Leader as a temporary measure. Gentle and dutiful, but
a poor negotiator.

Head of the 3rd Development Department at
<Ashurey Kreuzer>'s German branch. At the request of E-Selda
Shune, alias Seldoa Shiun, this department head secretly
developed the Bellzelute Brigandi.

The person who leads the civil officials called
"<Chancellor>s" among the group called the "Fury." Holds the
rank of "Chief Chancellor." Princess Shana-Mia's political
advisor.

An officer in the <Earth Federation Army>'s intelligence
department. Stationed at the Far East Command's Izu Base
and doing clerical work, this officer's talent was discovered
by Gilliam after a certain incident, and became one of his
direct subordinates.

A member of the "<Golaikunru>," the <Zovorg>'s war
profiteers. Judging by the surname, this person is thought
to hold the highest rank or an equivalent post, but the
details are unknown. Full of curiosity and fond of new
things.

strings.en:
A mercenary of the "<Golaikunru>," the <Zovorg>'s war
profiteers. Gentle in appearance and manner of speech,
but fairly realistic and dry by nature. A skilled humanoid
mobile weapon pilot.
